sentences.zh: 後唐長興三年四月，中書門下奏：「據《十道圖》，舊制以王者所都之地為上，本朝都長安，遂以關內道為上。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year of Changxing of Later Tang, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "According to the Atlas of the Ten Circuits, the old rule ranked first the place where the king dwelt; our dynasty's capital was Chang'an, and therefore the Guannei Circuit was ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Changxing 3 of Later Tang, the Secretariat and Chancellery submitted: "According to the Atlas of the Ten Circuits, the former rule gave first rank to the ruler's seat; our dynasty had its capital at Chang'an, so the Guannei Circuit was placed first.

sentences.zh: 今宗廟宮闕皆在洛陽，請以河南道為上，關內道為二，河東道第三，河北道第四，劍南道第五，江南道第六，淮南道第七，山南道第八，隴右道第九，嶺南道第十。

translations.literal: Now the ancestral temples and palace halls are all at Luoyang; we request that the Henan Circuit be ranked first, Guannei second, Hedong third, Hebei fourth, Jiannan fifth, Jiangnan sixth, Huainan seventh, Shannan eighth, Longyou ninth, and Lingnan tenth."
translations.idiomatic: Now that the ancestral temples and palace compounds are all at Luoyang, we ask that the Henan Circuit be ranked first, Guannei second, Hedong third, Hebei fourth, Jiannan fifth, Jiangnan sixth, Huainan seventh, Shannan eighth, Longyou ninth, and Lingnan tenth."

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

translations.idiomatic: (In the sixth month of Qingtai 3 of Later Tang, Qin Prefecture submitted: "Jie Prefecture originally administered Jiangli and Fujin counties and had no relocated garrisons; Cheng Prefecture originally administered Tonggu County, while the rest were garrisons whose tax and corvée were collected directly.

sentences.zh: 今欲取成州西南近便鎮分並入同谷縣，其東界四鎮，別創一縣者，州西南有府城、長豐、魏平三鎮，其地東至泥陽鎮界二十五里，北至黃竹路金砂鎮界五十里，南至興州界三十里，西至白石鎮界一百一十里，西南至舊階州界砂地嶺四十五里。

translations.literal: We now wish to take convenient garrisons in the southwest of Cheng Prefecture and merge them into Tonggu County; for the four garrisons on the eastern border, a separate county should be created. In the southwest of the prefecture are the three garrisons of Fucheng, Changfeng, and Weiping; their territory extends east to the border of Niyang Garrison at twenty-five li, north to the border of Jinsha Garrison on the Huangzhu Road at fifty li, south to the border of Xing Prefecture at thirty li, west to the border of Baishi Garrison at one hundred ten li, and southwest to Shadiling on the old border with Jie Prefecture at forty-five li.
translations.idiomatic: We now wish to merge convenient garrisons in Cheng Prefecture's southwest into Tonggu County; for the four garrisons on the eastern border, a separate county should be created. In the prefecture's southwest are the three garrisons of Fucheng, Changfeng, and Weiping, bounded east by Niyang Garrison at twenty-five li, north by Jinsha Garrison on the Huangzhu Road at fifty li, south by Xing Prefecture at thirty li, west by Baishi Garrison at one hundred ten li, and southwest by Shadiling on the old Jie border at forty-five li.

sentences.zh: 其三鎮管界並入同谷縣，廢其鎮額。

translations.literal: The jurisdictions of these three garrisons should be merged into Tonggu County and their garrison designations abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The jurisdictions of these three garrisons shall be merged into Tonggu County and their garrison designations abolished.

sentences.zh: 州東界有勝仙、泥陽、金砂、栗亭四鎮，東至鳳州美贍鎮界十五里，南至果州界二十里，北至高橋三十五里，西至同谷界三十五里，北至秦州界六十七里，欲並其四鎮地於栗亭縣。

translations.literal: On the prefecture's eastern border are the four garrisons of Shengxian, Niyang, Jinsha, and Liting; east to the border of Meishan Garrison in Feng Prefecture is fifteen li, south to the border of Guo Prefecture twenty li, north to Gaoqiao thirty-five li, west to the border with Tonggu thirty-five li, north to the border with Qin Prefecture sixty-seven li; we wish to merge the territories of these four garrisons into Liting County.
translations.idiomatic: On the prefecture's eastern border are the four garrisons of Shengxian, Niyang, Jinsha, and Liting, bounded east by Meishan Garrison in Feng Prefecture at fifteen li, south by Guo Prefecture at twenty li, north by Gaoqiao at thirty-five li, west by Tonggu at thirty-five li, and north by Qin Prefecture at sixty-seven li; we ask to merge the territories of these four garrisons into Liting County.

sentences.zh: 其征科委縣司，捕盜委鎮司。

translations.literal: Tax and corvée collection should be entrusted to the county office, and bandit suppression to the garrison office.
translations.idiomatic: Tax and corvée collection shall be entrusted to the county office, and bandit suppression to the garrison office.

translations.literal: (In the third month of the third year of Kaiyun of Jin, Quanyi County of Gui Prefecture was elevated to a prefecture; Quanyi County was renamed Dechang County, and Linchuan, Guangming, and Yining counties of Gui Prefecture were detached and placed under it, following the memorial of Ma Xifan of Hunan.)
translations.idiomatic: (In the third month of Kaiyun 3 of Jin, Quanyi County in Gui Prefecture was elevated to prefectural status; Quanyi was renamed Dechang County, and Linchuan, Guangming, and Yining counties were detached from Gui and placed under it, following the memorial of Ma Xifan of Hunan.)
